  • Je verkent opportuniteiten om bijkomende databronnen en analysetechnieken (zoals ruimtelijke data, AI of geavanceerde visualisaties) te integreren wanneer deze een duidelijke meerwaarde bieden voor strategische inzichten.
  • Je volgt de AI en machine learning evoluties actief op en denkt mee na over hoe ze het strategisch modelleren kunnen versterken.

Waarom is deze job iets voor jou?

  • Je beschikt over een masterdiploma bij voorkeur in wiskunde, statistiek, data science, ingenieurswetenschappen of een andere kwantitatieve richting) (of gelijkwaardig door ervaring) EN een ervaring van minstens 4 jaar ervaring in de industrie als data scientist.

EN je beschikt over de volgende vaardigheden:

  • Je hebt een sterke Python‑kennis voor data wrangling data‑analyse en modellering.
  • Je hebt een goede en aantoonbare kennis van PySpark en het werken met grotere datasets. PySpark is een kerncompetentie voor deze functie.
  • Je hebt ervaring met het industrialiseren van analyses of modellen.
  • Je kan autonoom werken, neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je opdrachten en weet zelfstandig tot oplossing te komen, met de nodige afstemming binnen het team.
  • Je communiceert vlot, zowel in het Nederlands als in het Engels en je kan complexe modellen en assumpties helder toelichten aan niet‑technische stakeholders.
  • Je hebt een gestructureerde mindset en bent oplossings- en kwaliteitsgericht.
  • Heb je interesse in machine learning, AI-toepassingen, geografische data of GIS-tools, transport, mobiliteit of complexe operationele systemen? Die zijn extra troeven.

Indien je jouw diploma in het buitenland hebt behaald, dien je in het bezit te zijn van een gelijkwaardigheidsattest afgeleverd door de Vlaamse Overheid (NARIC-Vlaanderen) om deel te kunnen nemen aan de selectie.

We vinden het dan ook belangrijk dat je jezelf kan zijn. Want dat maakt NMBS sterker. Daarom hechten we veel belang aan diversiteit en inclusie .

Wat mag je van ons verwachten?

Kiezen voor NMBS is kiezen voor een omgeving waarin je kan bijleren en groeien. Je wordt gesteund en omringd door fijne collega's. Als Data Scientist krijg je een loonpakket dat bestaat uit:

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris aangevuld met een 13e maand, onkostenvergoeding, maaltijdcheques en een collectieve en individuele bonus.
  • Een deel van het salaris wordt aangeboden als een flexibel budget. Je kan daarbij kiezen voor fietslease, lease auto, terugbetaling pensioensparen, ...
  • Een hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering.
  • Flexibele werkuren, de mogelijkheid om te telewerken en 33 vakantiedagen per jaar.
  • Een treinabonnement in België, kortingen op internationale treinreizen en een fietsvergoeding.
  • Voordelen voor je gezin: o.a. kortingen op gezinsactiviteiten en in winkelketens.

Waar ga je werken?

Je werkt in de buurt van het station Brussel-Zuid, in het gebouw Delta.

What’s next?

  • Je solliciteert online en je voegt een motivatiebrief toe. Beschrijf daarin kort je professionele ervaring met PySpark: hoeveel jaar ervaring je hebt, hoe recent je ermee hebt gewerkt en in welke context. Vermeld ook je ervaring met Databricks of vergelijkbare platformen. Vertel tot slot waarom deze functie je aanspreekt.
  • We screenen je CV en motivatiebrief. Bij een positieve screening volgt een HR-gesprek om je motivatie en match met NMBS te bespreken. We stellen ook enkele technische verkennende vragen.
  • Verloopt dit positief? Je ontvangt een technische opdracht die besproken wordt in een tweede gesprek. Ter voorbereiding op dit gesprek vragen we jou om een online persoonlijkheidsvragenlijst in te vullen.
  • Op basis van de volledige selectieprocedure kiezen we de best passende kandidaat. Daarna volgt een kennismaking met de Head of Corporate Strategy en de betrokken leidinggevende.
  • Verloopt deze laatste kennismaking goed? Er volgt dan een contractvoorstel.
  • Je bent klaar voor je eerste werkdag!

Wij behouden ons het recht om deze procedure aan te passen of op te schorten indien nodig. Ons rekruteringsteam zal de profielen selecteren die het best aansluiten bij de functie-eisen om een optimale match te garanderen.

Title: Senior Data Scientist – Vehicle Behaviour & Customer Intelligence
Description:
We are Btech (Barcelona Technical Center SL), a Spanish engineering company specialising in vehicle component design and calculation. Headquartered in Martorell, near Barcelona, we work with leading clients in the automotive, railway, aerospace, chemical and energy sectors.

We are currently looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join an automotive R&D project for one of our OEM clients.




Your mission

You will analyse real-world vehicle and driving data, connecting telemetry with customer surveys, personas and behavioural indicators. Your work will help transform complex engineering data into practical, explainable insights for vehicle development and customer intelligence.




Main responsibilities

Analyse vehicle, driving and unstructured data —such as customer survey verbatims— to identify meaningful driving patterns and behaviours.
Develop interpretable features and behavioural dimensions from vehicle telemetry and driving data.
Link real-world vehicle data with surveys, customer personas and behavioural indicators.
Explore, assess and quickly test relevant analytical methods through Proofs of Concept on real-world data.
Compare and apply statistical and machine learning approaches, including clustering, dimensionality reduction, factor analysis, correlation analysis and supervised/unsupervised models.
Validate models and analytical results, assessing robustness, reliability, assumptions and limitations.
Work closely with vehicle engineering teams to ensure findings are technically meaningful and aligned with real vehicle behaviour.
Communicate insights, conclusions and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of analytical methodologies, tools and data-driven decision-making within the project.




The profile we are looking for

Around 4–8 years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning or Advanced Analytics.
Strong Python skills for data analysis, modelling and prototyping.
Solid knowledge of statistics, machine learning, feature engineering and model validation.
Ability to work independently with complex, real-world datasets.
Strong communication skills and an engineering-oriented mindset.
Professional level of English.
Availability to relocate to Brussels and work on-site in a multicultural and international environment.




Nice to have

Experience in automotive, mobility, telemetry, IoT or industrial data.
Experience with customer analytics, surveys, personas, UX or behavioural data.
Knowledge of SQL, Snowflake, Databricks or similar platforms.
Experience with NLP, LLMs or AI-assisted analytics.




What do we offer?

An international automotive R&D project with a leading OEM.
A collaborative and multidisciplinary engineering environment.
Professional development opportunities and a competitive package aligned with your experience.




Ready for the challenge?

If you enjoy applying data science to real engineering challenges and want to contribute to understanding vehicle behaviour and customer experience, we would be delighted to meet you.

Title: Data scientist _FR
Description:
Comment pouvez-vous faire la différence ?

En tant que Data scientist – dans le service Corporate strategy, vous développez et maintenez des modèles stratégiques qui fournissent des insights approfondis et qui contribuent directement aux choix politiques et aux décisions d’investissement.

Vous travaillez à l’intersection des données, du business et de la stratégie et vous veillez à ce que des hypothèses et calculs complexes soient implémentés de manière transparente, robuste et reproductible dans des solutions de données évolutives.

Vous intégrez une équipe agile où PySpark occupe une place centrale dans le développement de solutions data. Nous travaillons avec Azure Databricks, Azure DevOps et VS Code. La collaboration, le partage de connaissance et la qualité sont essentiels.

Quel est votre rôle à la SNCB ?

En tant que Data scientist, vous aurez les responsabilités suivantes :


Vous développez, maintenez et industrialisez des modèles stratégiques sur la base d’hypothèses métier, en collaboration avec les parties prenantes concernées.
Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec des collègues de différentes directions de la SNCB dans un contexte transversal à l’échelle de toute l’organisation.
Vous traduisez des modèles existants, aujourd’hui gérés localement, en solutions PySpark robustes et évolutives.
Vous automatisez le traitement des données et l’exécution des modèles via des pipelines dans Databricks.
Vous travaillez avec Python et PySpark dans un environnement Azure Databricks pour traiter les données, implémenter des modèles et réaliser des analyses.
Vous veillez à la transparence, à la reproductibilité et au respect des bonnes pratiques lors de l’implémentation des modèles.
Vous explorez les opportunités d’intégrer des sources de données et des techniques analytiques supplémentaires (telles que les données spatiales, l’IA ou des visualisations avancées) lorsqu’elles apportent une réelle valeur ajoutée aux insights stratégiques.
Vous suivez activement les évolutions IA et machine learning et réfléchissez à la manière dont elles peuvent renforcer la modélisation stratégique.


Un job fait pour vous ?


Vous avez un master, de préférence en mathématiques, statistiques, data science, sciences de l’ingénieur ou une autre discipline quantitative (ou équivalent par expérience) ET une expérience de minimum 4 ans en tant que data scientist en industrie.


ET vous disposez des compétences suivantes :


Vous êtes doté.e d’une solide connaissance de Python pour le data wrangling, l’analyse de données et la modélisation.
Vous avez de l’expérience avec PySpark et le travail avec de grands volumes de données.
Vous avez de l’expérience dans l’industrialisation d’analyses ou de modèles (par exemple la migration d’Excel vers du code de production).
Vous communiquez aisément, aussi bien en français qu’en anglais et pouvez expliquer clairement des modèles complexes et des hypothèses à des parties prenantes non techniques.
Vous avez un esprit structuré et êtes orienté.e solution et qualité.
Vous avez un intérêt pour le machine learning, les applications d’IA, les données géographiques ou outils GIS (par ex. QGIS, ArcGIS), le transport, la mobilité ou des systèmes opérationnels complexes ? Il s’agit d’atouts en plus.


Si vous avez obtenu votre diplôme à l'étranger, vous devez être en possession d'une attestation d'équivalence délivrée par la Communauté française pour pouvoir participer à la sélection.

Chaque personne est unique. Il est important pour nous que vous puissiez être vous-même. C’est ce qui rend la SNCB plus forte. C’est pourquoi nous accordons beaucoup d’importance à la diversité et à l’inclusion .

Qu'avons-nous à vous offrir ?

Choisir la SNCB, c'est choisir un environnement où vous pouvez apprendre et vous épanouir. Vous serez entouré de chouettes collègues qui vous soutiendront. En tant que Data Scientist, vous recevez un package salarial qui se compose de :


Un salaire attractif complété d'un 13e mois, d'une indemnité de frais, des chèques-repas et d'un bonus collectif et individuel.
Une partie du salaire est offerte sous forme de budget flexible. Vous pouvez opter pour la location d'un vélo, une voiture en leasing, pour le remboursement de l'épargne-pension, etc.
Une assurance hospitalisation et collective.
Un horaire flexible, un bon équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée grâce à 33 jours de congés par an.
Un abonnement de train en Belgique, des avantages sur les lignes internationales et une indemnité vélo.
Des avantages pour votre famille comme des réductions sur les sorties en famille et dans les magasins.


Où allez-vous travailler ?

Vous travaillerez à proximité de la gare du Midi, dans le bâtiment Delta.

What’s next ?


Vous postulez en ligne et ajoutez votre lettre de motivation. Vous y décrivez brièvement votre expérience professionnelle avec PySpark : le nombre d’années d’expérience, à quel point cette expérience est récente et dans quel contexte vous l’avez utilisé. Indiquez-y également votre expérience avec Databricks ou des plateformes comparables. Finalement, racontez-nous ce qui vous attire dans ce job.
Nous analysons votre CV et lettre de motivation. Le screening est positif ? Un court entretien HR pour discuter de votre motivation, du match avec la SNCB est planifié. Nous vous posons également quelques questions techniques.
L’entretien est positif ? Vous recevez alors un exercice technique qui sera abordé pendant le 2e entretien. Pour préparer cet entretien, vous complétez un questionnaire de personnalité en ligne.
Sur la base de l’ensemble de la procédure de sélection, nous choisissions le candidat ou la candidate qui convient le mieux. Vous faites alors la connaissance du Head of Corporate strategy et du manager.
Si cette dernière rencontre est positive, vous recevez une proposition salariale.
Vous commencez votre nouveau job !


Nous nous réservons le droit d'ajuster ou de suspendre cette procédure en cas de nécessité. Notre équipe de recrutement sélectionnera les profils les plus en adéquation avec les exigences du poste afin de garantir une correspondance optimale.

Title: Data Scientist - GenAI
Description:
Join Artefact Belgium: Shape the Future of Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)

Are you an early-career professional excited to harness the power of generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)? Artefact Belgium is seeking a Data Scientist - Gen AI to join our innovative team in Brussels. Our Belgian team specializes in LLM and GenAI projects, and this is your chance to work on cutting-edge solutions, collaborate with top-tier experts, and contribute to impactful projects in a dynamic, forward-thinking environment.

Who You Are

A recent graduate or professional with 1 to 3 years of experience, with hands-on experience working with LLMs and a passion for generative AI and NLP. Motivated to apply your technical expertise to real-world challenges in AI. Able to thrive in collaborative settings while independently driving your own workstreams. Eager to learn, grow, and push the boundaries of what's possible in AI innovation.

Who We Are

Artefact is a leading Data & AI consulting firm operating at the forefront of AI innovation. With a global presence, we help clients across industries—public health, manufacturing, etc. —leverage generative AI to achieve transformative outcomes. Our team in Belgium is specialized in LLM and GenAI projects, working on the most advanced applications of these technologies. At Artefact, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning, with a strong commitment to inclusivity and employee growth.

What You Will Do


Collaborate with the team to design, train, and fine-tune state-of-the-art models for client projects and internal tools.
Develop and integrate agentic AI solutions using tool calling, and emerging protocols like Model Context Protocol (MCP) to create autonomous, context-aware applications.
Research and implement innovative generative AI applications to solve complex business problems.
Design and implement comprehensive evaluation frameworks to measure LLM performance, establishing quality metrics and benchmarks that guide development decisions and ensure reliable, production-ready solutions.
Optimize the performance, scalability, and usability of LLM-powered products and tools.
Contribute to the deployment and maintenance of AI systems, including models, APIs, and supporting infrastructure.
Participate in technical discussions and brainstorming sessions to shape impactful solutions.


What You Bring


A degree in computer science, mathematics, engineering, physics, or a related field.
Experience working with LLMs, generative AI, or advanced NLP applications (e.g., fine-tuning models, using frameworks like Hugging Face or OpenAI).
Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with AI and NLP libraries.
Analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with an ability to address real-world challenges through AI.
Good communication skills in English, Dutch or French; additional languages are a plus.
A growth mindset, adaptability, and eagerness to work in a fast-paced, cutting-edge environment.


What We Offer


A competitive salary with benefits tailored for early-career professionals.
Hands-on experience with state-of-the-art LLM technologies in impactful projects.
A dynamic and supportive work environment that fosters creativity and professional development.
Resources for ongoing training, certification, and skill-building in generative AI and related fields.
A collaborative, inclusive workplace with access to global expertise through Artefact's network.


This position is based in Brussels.

Don't worry if you don't meet every criterion! We value passion, potential, and a commitment to innovation. If you're excited about generative AI and ready to grow your career, we'd love to hear from you!

Title: Job | GenAI - Data Scientist | Brussel
Description:
Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

AI- & ML-solution development


Machine learning- en deep learning-modellen (inclusief generative AI) inzetten om complexe bedrijfsproblemen op te lossen.
Modellen optimaliseren voor prestaties, schaalbaarheid en kostenefficiëntie in Azure-cloudomgevingen.
MLOps-pijplijnen implementeren om modeltraining, validatie en uitrol te automatiseren.



Cloud- & AI-infrastructuur


Schaalbare AI-infrastructuur ontwikkelen en onderhouden op Azure-cloudplatformen, gebruikmakend van diensten zoals Azure ML en AKS.
Zorgen voor veilige, conforme en hoog-beschikbare AI-implementaties in de cloud.



Generatieve AI & Innovatie


Generative AI-modellen (LLM’s, enz.) verkennen en integreren voor toepassingen zoals: RAG, intelligent document processing, speech-to-text en conversational AI.
Vooroplopen in AI-trends (bijv. fine-tuning, multimodal AI) en innovatieve use cases voorstellen.



Data- & modelgovernance


Zorgen voor datakwaliteit, bias-mitigatie en ethische AI-praktijken bij modelontwikkeling.
Modelmonitoring en explainability-tools implementeren om prestaties en compliance te volgen.



Samenwerking & stakeholder engagement


Samenwerken met productteams, data scientists en zakelijke stakeholders om AI-kansen te identificeren.
Zakelijke vereisten vertalen naar technische AI-oplossingen en inzichten effectief communiceren.



De job in een notendop

Je speelt een centrale rol in het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en implementeren van geavanceerde AI- en machine learning-oplossingen die innovatie en automatisering binnen de organisatie stimuleren.

Je werkt samen met cross-functionele teams om cloudgebaseerde AI-diensten, generatieve AI en schaalbare ML-infrastructuur te benutten.

Je zorgt ervoor dat AI-modellen robuust, ethisch verantwoord en afgestemd zijn op de bedrijfsdoelstellingen.

Jij hoeft geen witte raaf te zijn

Al kan je er bij ons wel één worden. Bij ons mag je volop je vleugels uitslaan als je iemand bent met:


Een master of doctoraat in de wetenschappen met uitstekende academische resultaten op technisch gebied (econometrie, computerwetenschappen, artificiële intelligentie, e.a.).
Deskundigheid op het vlak van
machine learning technieken en bereidheid om die kennis up-to-date te houden; een diepgaande kennis van algoritmes zoals Random Forests, Neural Networks en reinforcement learning is hierbij een must.
genAI: prompt engineering, structured outputs, ...(zie verantwoordelijkheden).

Sterke programmeervaardigheden in Python en SQL.
Uitgebreide kennis van Nederlands of Frans, met passieve kennis van de andere taal, en Engels.
Ervaring in het verklaren van complexe analyses aan een niet-technisch publiek aan de hand van je verhalende competenties en je capaciteit om data te visualiseren; je beschikt over uitmuntende mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatievaardigheden op technisch en businessniveau.
Honger naar kennis, niet alleen om nieuwe algoritmes en technologieën te beheersen, maar ook op interpersoonlijk vlak; je bent je ervan bewust dat de waarde van jouw werk neerkomt op kwaliteit x acceptatie en je wilt sleutelen aan beide aspecten.
Uitzonderlijke probleemoplossende vaardigheden: je weet dat het juiste inzicht in een probleem minstens 90% van de oplossing uitmaakt, je geeft blijk van creativiteit en volharding bij het doorgronden van problemen en het zoeken van oplossingen.


Je scoort extra met:


Tweetaligheid (Engels en Nederlands of Frans).
Ervaring met het bouwen van dataproducten, van ontwerp tot productie.
Wat full-stack skills.
Kennis van cloud, bij voorkeur Azure.



Belfius koestert zijn talenten

Behalve de kans om elke dag te shinen, bieden wij jou een fulltime contract van onbepaalde duur met:


Een mooi loon aangevuld met een innovatief aanbod om een persoonlijk budget samen te stellen dat je kan besteden volgens je voorkeuren (bv. wagen, fiets, pc, smartphone, tablet, huisvesting onder bepaalde voorwaarden) en extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, personeelsvoordeel op eigen producten en diensten, en een hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering.
Mogelijkheden te over om je te ontwikkelen door een brede waaier aan opleidingen en carrièrekansen in de hele Belfius-groep.
Een goede werk-privé balans dankzij flexibele uren, de combinatie kantoor- en thuiswerk en een aantrekkelijk aantal vakantiedagen.
Een moderne werkplek in het hart van Brussel met een coole fitness, een lekker gezond restaurant en gezellige ontmoetingsruimtes, dit alles op wandelafstand van de winkelstraat, het treinstation Brussel-Noord en de metrohalte Rogier.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Are you an experienced data scientist? Do you know how to create reliable predictions and optimal decisions based on complex and large datasets? Do you want to put your talent to use and contribute to the energy transition by building innovative energy management solutions?




What you'll work on

Probabilistic forecasting of electricity consumption and on-site generation at client premises — not only point forecasts, but the uncertainty estimates the control layer needs to make defensible decisions.
Turning forecasts into control actions: converting forecasts and price signals into dispatch decisions across our clients' assets — batteries, PV and EV charging — with a single objective, minimizing their energy bill. In practice this means formulating and solving a constrained optimisation problem over each site's tariff structure, capacity limits and asset behavior, and doing it well enough that the result holds up when the forecast turns out to be wrong.
Real-time execution, including control logic running on edge devices, that stays stable when conditions deviate from plan.
Closing the loop between prediction, decision and execution, so the system runs unattended and improves on its own operating history. In practice: tracking forecast error against realized load and generation to drive retraining; comparing the savings actually achieved against what the optimiser expected, and attributing the gap to the forecast, the formulation or the asset; and correcting our models of the assets themselves — round-trip efficiency, degradation, state-of-charge drift — against what the fleet really does.
R&D delivery: work alongside our Research Manager and top tier Research institutes on the data science workstreams of our ongoing research projects.




What we're looking for

Mathematical optimisation is essential for this role: linear and quadratic programming, mixed-integer formulations, and ideally stochastic programming. You should be comfortable moving from a business objective to a formulation, and from a formulation to something that solves reliably within an operational time budget.
A strong foundation in machine learning, time series forecasting and statistical modelling.
Practical experience with real-time control algorithms on edge devices — PID, rule-based supervisory control, MPC, or comparable approaches you have deployed and maintained in the field.
A problem solver by instinct: you're comfortable being handed an ambiguous situation, working out what's actually going on, and deciding what to do about it.
The ability to explain a complex model or control decision to a non-technical audience — colleagues in sales and operations, and clients who want to understand why their battery did what it did.
Commercial judgement: you can tell the difference between the solution that is optimal on paper and the one that goes live this quarter and starts paying for itself.
Fluency in Python.




A clear plus

Working knowledge of energy systems: electricity markets, load forecasting, asset dispatch, balancing mechanisms.
Experience with AI Coding.
Experience with AWS.
A track record with messy field data — gaps, drift, sensors that contradict one another.
Experience shipping models and controllers into production systems that run unattended, with monitoring in place. Notebooks are where the work starts, not where it ends.




What's in it for you

Hardware in the loop. Your algorithms don't stop at an API boundary. They move megawatts through equipment installed at real sites.
A short feedback loop. Models go live, are measured against real financial outcomes, and get improved. You'll know within days whether an idea worked.
Room to set the direction. The team is small enough that your decisions about modelling, tooling and control architecture become the way Octave.energy does it.
A mission with urgency. A renewable grid runs on flexibility: shifting demand towards the hours when the wind blows and the sun shines. Batteries, PV and EV charging are the three levers we pull, and better forecasting and control get more out of each of them.




We also offer

An attractive salary package
Offices in Mechelen and Brussels
Flexible hours and hybrid working (2–3 days in the office)
A collaborative team with genuine room to learn and grow in a fast-growing cleantech scale-up
An attractive benefits package: Car/mobility budget, hospitalization & group insurance, training budget, cafeteria plan with 13th-month optimization, €10/day of lunch vouchers, eco-cheques and extra benefits (e.g., gym subscription).




About Octave.energy

Founded in April 2020, Octave.energy is a Belgian cleantech company specialized in battery energy storage and energy management services for businesses. We have sold over 200 MWh of storage capacity and operate the largest fleet of behind-the-meter batteries in Belgium. Backed by private investors, imec, and the European Commission's EIC Accelerator, we work at the forefront of the energy transition.




Interested?

Send your CV to recruitment@octave.energy, along with a few lines about something you've built — a forecasting model, a controller you designed, a project that shows how you approach a problem. We'll get back to you shortly.

Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

Your Role

As an R&D Data Scientist, you will play a key role in:


Analysing vehicle telemetry, driving data, and unstructured data sources (including verbatim text) to build interpretable features and dimensions that define driving patterns and behaviours.
Linking real-world telemetry data with survey responses, customer personas, and behavioural indicators to generate a rich, multi-dimensional understanding of driver profiles.
Reviewing relevant academic and technical literature, assessing applicability to the project, and rapidly testing approaches through proof-of-concepts on real, messy data.
Comparing and validating analytical methods — including clustering, dimensionality reduction, factor analysis, and supervised/unsupervised modelling — with rigorous attention to robustness, reliability, and limitations.
Collaborating with engineers to ensure findings are technically grounded, and communicating results clearly with well-reasoned recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Your Profile


Technical depth: Strong proficiency in Python for analysis, modelling and prototyping, combined with solid foundations in statistics, machine learning and AI — including feature engineering, dimensionality reduction and model validation.
Applied research capability: Able to read and critically assess technical material, adapt methods to real-world constraints, and design experiments on complex, ambiguous datasets — going well beyond running standard pipelines.
Engineering sensitivity: You understand what your data physically and behaviourally represents, and can judge whether results make sense in context — not just statistically, but meaningfully.
Communication and autonomy: You work independently, structure your own analyses, challenge weak or ambiguous results, and clearly communicate assumptions, limitations and conclusions to diverse audiences.
Fluent in English
Minimum 4 years of experience


What You Will Love About Working Here


Empowering environment - Autonomy and Goal setting are among the top scores with 8,4+ ratings in our monthly employee feedback Pulse.
FlexAbroad - Employees in 20+ countries can work abroad for up to 45 days in a 12-month period.
Free access to learning platforms - Free access for all to world-class learning assets and curated programs from Harvard Business Review, Coursera, Pluralsight, Udemy, Microsoft, AWS, Google and many more.
Worldwide Leader of Engineering Services - Capgemini Engineering combines its broad industry knowledge and cutting-edge technologies in digital and software to support the convergence of the physical and digital worlds. We help our clients unleashing their R&D potential to develop smart products and services of tomorrow.

Title: Job | GenAI - Data Scientist | Bruxelles
Description:
Description

Vous jouez un rôle central dans la conception, le développement et la mise en œuvre de solutions d’IA et d’apprentissage automatique avancées, favorisant l’innovation et l’automatisation au sein de l’organisation.

Vous collaborez avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires pour tirer parti des services d’IA dans le cloud, de l’IA générative et d’une infrastructure d’apprentissage automatique évolutive.

Vous veillez à ce que les modèles d’IA soient robustes, éthiques et alignés sur les objectifs commerciaux.

Votre job en deux mots

Principales responsabilités :

Développement de solutions d’IA et d’apprentissage automatique :

Déploiement de modèles d’apprentissage automatique et d’apprentissage profond (y compris l’IA générative) pour résoudre des problèmes métier complexes.

Optimisation des modèles en termes de performance, d’évolutivité et de rentabilité dans les environnements cloud Azure.

Mise en œuvre de pipelines MLOps pour automatiser l’entraînement, la validation et le déploiement des modèles.

Infrastructure cloud et d’IA :

Développement et maintenance d’une infrastructure d’IA évolutive sur les plateformes cloud Azure, en utilisant des services tels qu’Azure ML et AKS.

Garantie de déploiements d’IA sécurisés, conformes et hautement disponibles dans le cloud. IA générative et innovation.

Explorer et intégrer des modèles d'IA générative (LLM, etc.) pour des applications telles que : RAG (Real Agile Agile), traitement intelligent de documents, transcription vocale et IA conversationnelle.

Anticiper les tendances en IA (par exemple, le fine-tuning, l'IA multimodale) et proposer des cas d'usage innovants.

Gouvernance des données et des modèles

Garantir la qualité des données, la réduction des biais et le respect des pratiques éthiques en matière d'IA lors du développement des modèles.

Mettre en œuvre des outils de surveillance et d'explicabilité des modèles afin de suivre leurs performances et leur conformité.

Collaboration et mobilisation des parties prenantes

Collaborer avec les équipes produit, les data scientists et les parties prenantes métier pour identifier les opportunités offertes par l'IA.

Traduire les besoins métier en solutions techniques d'IA et communiquer efficacement les résultats obtenus.

Pas besoin d’être un oiseau rare

Mais vous pouvez en devenir un, parmi nous. Chez nous, vous pouvez vous distinguer et révéler le meilleur de vous-même si vous répondez aux critères suivants:


Un master ou un doctorat en sciences, avec d'excellents résultats académiques dans des domaines techniques (économétrie, informatique, intelligence artificielle, etc.).
Une expertise en
techniques d'apprentissage automatique et la volonté de maintenir vos connaissances à jour ; une connaissance approfondie d'algorithmes tels que les forêts
aléatoires, les réseaux de neurones et l'apprentissage par renforcement est indispensable.
GenAI : ingénierie rapide, résultats structurés, etc. (voir les responsabilités).
De solides compétences en programmation Python et SQL.
Une excellente maîtrise du néerlandais ou du français, avec des notions de l'autre langue, et de l'anglais.
Une expérience dans la vulgarisation d'analyses complexes auprès d'un public non technique, grâce à vos talents de conteur et votre capacité à visualiser les données. Vous possédez d'excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite, tant sur le plan technique que commercial.
Une soif d'apprendre, non seulement pour maîtriser de nouveaux algorithmes et technologies, mais aussi sur le plan relationnel ; vous êtes conscient(e) que la valeur de votre travail repose sur la qualité et l'acceptation, et vous souhaitez travailler sur ces deux aspects.
Des compétences exceptionnelles en résolution de problèmes : vous savez qu'une bonne compréhension d'un problème représente au moins 90 % de la solution ; vous faites preuve de créativité et de persévérance pour comprendre les problèmes et trouver des solutions.


Un plus :


Bilinguisme (anglais et néerlandais ou français).
Expérience en développement de produits de données, de la conception à la production.
Compétences en développement full-stack.
Connaissance du cloud, de préférence Azure.



Belfius prend soin de ses talents

Outre la possibilité de faire votre chemin dans un job qui vous plaît, nous vous offrons un contrat à temps plein à durée indéterminée avec :


Un salaire attractif complété par une offre innovante vous octroyant un budget à utiliser selon vos préférences personnelles (p. ex. voiture, vélo, PC, smartphone, tablette, loyer ou crédit hypothécaire sous certaines conditions) et des avantages extralégaux, tels que des chèques-repas, des avantages sur les produits et services internes, une assurance hospitalisation et une assurance groupe.
Des possibilités de développement par le biais d'un large éventail de formations et des opportunités de carrière dans l’ensemble du groupe Belfius.
Un bon équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée grâce à des horaires flexibles, à la combinaison du travail au bureau et à domicile et un nombre attractif de jours de congé.
Un lieu de travail moderne au cœur de Bruxelles, avec une salle de sport branchée, un délicieux restaurant sain et des espaces de réunion confortables, le tout à quelques pas de la rue commerciale, de la gare Bruxelles-Nord et de la station métro Rogier.

Title: Data Scientist - Agriculture & Nature Analytics
Description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

You’ll work with McKinsey’s agricultural and nature analytics team (ACRE) in Brussels, Belgium, part of our Agriculture Practice and Nature & Natural Capital Service Line.

Our Agriculture Practice advises agribusiness, consumer food, government, and investor clients on strategic, marketing & sales, and operations issues, helping support industry-shaping decisions that impact the future of global food production.

The Nature & Natural Capital Service Line helps corporations, public-sector actors and institutions in enabling nature-positive outcomes by integrating biodiversity, land use, water, and ecosystem information into strategy, investment decisions, and operations.

Within this group, ACRE is a team of ~30 expert consultants, data scientists, and engineers focused on bringing cutting-edge analytics to our clients. We apply real-time data and advanced analytics or AI – generally predictive or geospatial in nature – to solve the biggest problems currently facing global agriculture and nature.

You will leverage industry knowledge and analytical expertise to provide insights both to clients as part of client service teams and within the ACRE team by strengthening the core products and algorithms we build for clients. You can expect to split your time delivering impact at clients (either remotely or on site) and building up ACRE’s core analytical offerings.

In the agriculture sector, issues to solve could include determining the suitability of growing different types of crops across different geographies, using local agronomic data and satellite imagery to determine market potential for input products, or optimizing farm operations using yield forecasting. For the nature sector, you may help public-sector clients from low- and middle-income clients define their nature conservation strategy, supporting them through geospatial analysis and your domain knowledge.

Along the way, you will receive best-in-class training in structuring business problems and serving as a client adviser, develop tech-skills through (in-person) trainings curated by big-tech companies, and have opportunities to work closely with and learn from our senior agriculture and nature leaders and industry players that are shaping the future of these fields. You will get access to unparalleled career acceleration, with a huge amount of ownership and responsibility from the get-go in a collaborative, diverse, non-hierarchical environment. You will get the opportunity to travel to client sites and attend in-person trainings, locally and around the world. Lastly, you will be able to provide direct and measurable impact towards solving some of the largest problems facing the global food-system and natural ecosystems.

Your Qualifications and Skills


Master’s in a quantitative agriculture- or nature-related field
Strong experience with agronomy/crop science, animal sciences and farm-level production systems, AND/OR nature- and natural-capital–related topics, such as biodiversity, land use, water systems, ecosystem services, or nature-related risk and impact assessment, preferred
Geospatial and spatiotemporal analysis, remote sensing, image processing, preferred
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, paired with the ability to develop creative and efficient solutions
Clean, efficient coding abilities in Python ideally with experience parallel processing and using cloud computing resources
Ability to design and develop geospatial workflows and pipelines for data analysis and processing; ability to use version-control & collaboration tools
Strong multitasking and parallel development abilities
Strong interpersonal communication skills
Creative, naturally curious, and willing to take intellectual risks
Able to work under competing, quickly-changing priorities, manage expectations effectively and support the team under pressure
Self-management skills and ability to work as part of an Agile team preferred
Willingness to travel up to 50%

Title: Senior Consultant in Data science
Description:
Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility. We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity. With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes.





Job Description



As a Senior consultant in Data Science, you will be involved in transformation projects at our clients. You will execute project assignments in modelling and digital transformation (business/IT analysis and partial coding) environments with a good deal of business perspectives:



Machine learning, AI and statistics: developing predictive models of decision making (supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms, econometrics, forecasting, quantitative diagnosis,...)
Operational research : assistance in the design and implementation of constraint optimization solutions and simulation models
Big Data : Algorithmic knowledge for large and unstructured data processing

You will get the opportunity to actively contribute to Sia’s internal activities:



Development and reinforcement of our offer, by understanding and interpreting data science innovation and challenges
Business development, by contributing to need definition and participating in our commercial initiatives

As fast as possible, you will take up team leadership roles and connect with colleagues of all levels.



Equipped with the entrepreneurial fibre, you are ready to cooperate in a fast growing company.







In return, you can expect:



An international company that gives importance to diversity, inclusion, employee well-being and corporate social responsibilities actions.
A great working atmosphere with friendly and professional colleagues where innovation and entrepreneurship are encouraged
A personal development plan with a regular follow-up as well training opportunities to develop yourself
A competitive salary with great advantages, like mobility budget, hospital insurance, performance -related bonus,...


Qualifications


University Master Civil Engineer (applied mathematics, IT or similar)
2 to 6 years’ experience as a consultant
Outstanding team player with great interpersonal and communication skills
Strong interest in data science and related sectors such as Energy and Finance
You have a strong interest in data and AI-related topics, the ability to quickly build expertise in these areas, and you’re excited about helping our clients seize the opportunities they offer.
Analytical mind, exploring options and able to synthesize into conclusions
Dynamic, result oriented, rigorous and committed
Trilingual: French, Dutch and English
Prepared to participate in temporary assignments abroad


Additional Information



We are unable to provide a work permit for this position



Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

Title: Data Scientist Total Video
Description:
Amsterdam - Combine Data Science, AI, and Media to transform the advertising market. At DPG Media, our work touches over 90% of Dutch households daily. As a Data Scientist Total Video, you will take the lead in integrating TV advertising and digital video advertising into a scalable Total Video advertising product. If you are looking for a high-impact role where you can build an innovative data product from the ground up, this is your call.

What will you do?

As a Data Scientist Total Video, you develop data products at the intersection of data science, machine learning engineering, and AI to enable Total Video at scale. You provide the crucial holistic data focus needed to successfully integrate the worlds of TV advertising and online video advertising. With your expertise, you translate complex business challenges into concrete data solutions and contribute directly to the further development of an innovative product, that will transform the advertising market. You do this by:


Analyzing complex datasets and translating stakeholder challenges into concrete solutions, that you continuously improve iteratively
Developing and implementing scalable data products and models within a production environment
Collaborating within a dedicated development and product team on the realization of Total Video for the Belgian and Dutch markets
Working closely with Ad Alliance in the Netherlands and DPG Media Advertising in Belgium


Who are we?

We are the Total Video team, part of the Advertising Ecosystem & Strategy domain. In the coming years, we are investing heavily in the development of Total Video: a unique opportunity to help build a product from the ground up that will change the advertising market. The team is currently being built and consists of professionals with diverse backgrounds in business, data, product, and technology.

What makes you the ideal candidate?

For this role, we are looking for a person that is able to create and build things from scratch. Is optimistic, committed, driven, and creative. In addition, you bring:


5+ years experience in a similar role
Deep expertise in data science and machine learning, enabling you to design, train, and implement models in production environments
Experience transforming data models into scalable data products, preferably within a media or advertising environment
Strong analytical and conceptual skills, allowing you to recognize patterns in complex datasets and translate them into concrete solutions
Experience with machine learning tools and MLOps systems such as Docker, Databricks, and MLflow
Strong communication skills to clearly convey insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders


At DPG Media, we are open to all talent in society. Regardless of your background, we encourage you to apply for this role. It is precisely the differences between colleagues that lead to surprising insights and innovative solutions. And that fits perfectly with who we are as an organization. We are curious to learn more about you and the qualities and experience you bring. Want to know more about our inclusive working environment? Click here!

What do we offer?

You will join an inspiring work environment that is constantly evolving. You will work with colleagues who think in possibilities, see opportunities, and encourage you to continue developing yourself every day. We support this through our DPG Academy, giving you every opportunity to get the best out of yourself and grow as a true media maker.

💰 A salary that matches your experience

📝 A 36-hour working week

💰 8% holiday allowance and a 4% personal choice budget

💰 Annual profit sharing based on DPG Media’s performance

🎓 Plenty of opportunities for development, both on the job and online through our DPG Academy

🎉 Flexibility to align your own cultural holidays

🏢 A fantastic new office in Amsterdam (Mediavaert). From spontaneous drinks to team outings and our legendary staff party, you will quickly feel at home here!

Even more reasons to join DPG Media

At DPG Media, we work for more than 90 strong news brands, magazines, television programs, radio stations, and online services such as Qmusic, NU.nl, Tweakers, Libelle, VTM, and more. Every month, we reach over 90% of the Dutch population and 8 out of 10 Flemish people. We offer a professional work environment where freedom and ownership are highly valued. You will have every opportunity to work on your future through workshops and training programs. Feel free to be an entrepreneur, a learner, a team player, and above all, yourself. Everyone is welcome at DPG Media, regardless of background. More than 5,500 talented colleagues are ready to welcome you into a team, whether it is a project team, a pub quiz team, or a sports team.

Discover what we have to offer you. And while you are at it, you can also find us on Instagram, LinkedIn and X.

Applying, and then?

Ready to get started? Apply directly no later than January 12. You will receive a response to your application within 10 working days. Interviews will take place between January 13 and January 23, and final decisions will be communicated by January 31. If you are selected for the first round, we will contact you by phone to schedule an interview at our Amsterdam office.

Title: Machine Learning & Operations Research Specialist
Description:

As part of the international group bnode, bpost has transitioned from the Belgian postal operator to a regional and digital expert in parcel size logistics. With a focus on social and environmental sustainability, our people are the foundation of everything we do. We foster a culture that supports diversity, inclusion and career growth, ensuring that every team member has the opportunity to thrive and succeedWhat will you do?

Bpost is looking for a Data Scientist / Operations Research Specialist with proven experience building and industrializing machine learning and optimization solutions.

In Belgium, Bpost operates in a context of structural mail decline, continued parcel growth, increasing operational variability, and strong competitive pressure. Better forecasting and optimization are therefore key to improving service (quality) and network efficiency (cost) across sorting, transport and distribution.

In this role, you will design, prototype and industrialize analytical solutions that drive operational and tactical decisions across Bpost’s network. This includes building robust decision-support tools such as forecasting and optimization models, and ensuring they are deployed, monitored and used in real operations.

You will work closely with operational stakeholders and IT teams to turn business problems into scalable, production-ready solutions. You will also help increase the analytics maturity of Bpost by moving use cases from ad hoc analysis or prototype stage toward robust, reusable and business-embedded analytical products.

Who are you?


At least 5 years of proven experience using both machine learning and operations research to solve real-world problems
At least 5 years of proven experience designing, prototyping, deploying, and monitoring models in production environments
Ability to translate business needs into pragmatic analytical solutions
Interest in logistics, supply chain, and physical network decision-making
Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Full proficiency in English. French and Dutch are a strong plus.

Programming & analytics: Python, SQL, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn

Optimization: OR-Tools, Gurobi or similar solvers

Title: Fraud Data Analyst
Description:
EBA CLEARING is a provider of pan-European payment infrastructure solutions. Founded in 1998, the Company is owned by 48 of the major banks operating in Europe and based on a country-neutral governance model. The payment systems of EBA CLEARING are pan-European by design and desire: they are developed in close co-operation with the Company’s multinational user community and best-of-breed technology partners.

Join our team of smart and curious people from all over the world as we help shape the future of pan-European payments.




This position can be located in Brussels or Frankfurt.




The position




The FPAD Competence Centre (FCC) is responsible for the development and maintenance of fraud detection models for EBA CLEARING FPAD functionality. This requires data analysis and modelling as well as a good understanding of fraud developments and the needs of our users, supporting them in understanding FPAD functioning and results and help investigate specific cases.




As a member of the FCC team your responsibilities will include:




monitoring model and data quality in production
finding new emerging fraud characteristics by exploring the vast transaction data underlying our FPAD solution
building new features that help detect fraudulent transactions
developing state-of-the-art AI models against billions of historical transaction
creating documentation and charts to explain your work to our users
sharing insights with experts from financial institutions across Europe
staying up to date with latest trends in fraud detection and drive the development of our solution







The profile




The basics:

University degree in computer science, mathematics or a related field
At least three years of experience working in a quantitative role, in a fraud or risk environment at a bank or payment service provider
Good knowledge of data science and data engineering, preferably with python
Especially experience with
Experience to optimise models on response time
Working in a highly regulated environment
Domain knowledge in payment data
Full proficiency in English, any additional European languages would be an asset




Required skills:

Intercultural communication
Customer-first attitude in everyday responsibilities
Analytical thinking and efficient problem-solving
Ability to anticipate problems, needs and changes and evaluate operational risks
Attention to detail while managing multiple tasks simultaneously
Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced environment




What we offer




At EBA CLEARING, we develop ideas together within and across teams and with our stakeholders, and we are ready to adapt whenever needed. The projects waiting for you will give you the opportunity to learn, excel and grow. Our people are our most valuable asset, and we want to contribute to the well-being of our staff at work and beyond with:

a competitive salary package
attractive benefits package including a sports and cultural activities budget and meal tickets
professional development opportunities including training budgets and inner-company mobility
a flexible work environment including the option to work from home
happy work place initiatives including well-being workshops, social events, green initiatives, onboarding support and more

EBA CLEARING is committed to equal opportunity, diversity and inclusion, as we are convinced that our individual experiences and overall diversity are our key strength. All our recruitment decisions are based solely on the individual’s qualifications, skills and experience along with the job requirements. EBA CLEARING ensures compliance with the principle of non-discrimination towards any person in the context of a recruitment procedure, access to an internship or an in-company training period in the different countries in which it recruits.

If you have any question regarding the interview process, please let our Talent Acquisition Specialist know.




Visit our website to learn more about EBA CLEARING and submit your application via our career portal.

We value authenticity in our recruitment process and are interested in getting to know you, your experience, your perspective and your voice. While AI tools can support preparation, we expect applications and interactions to reflect your own work and thinking.

Title: Data scientist – Suivi épidémiologique des infections nosocomiales
Description:
Le service « Infections nosocomiales et résistance aux antibiotiques » fournit aux établissements de soins les outils nécessaires au suivi des infections nosocomiales, de la résistance aux antibiotiques et de l’utilisation des agents antimicrobiens, et contribue, par le biais d’activités de recherche et de surveillance, à la prévention des infections nosocomiales et de la résistance aux antibiotiques dans les établissements de soins aigus et chroniques. L'équipe met cette expertise au service des autorités sanitaires et apporte son soutien sur le terrain en cas d'épidémies liées à des micro-organismes, en particulier des bactéries souvent résistantes à plusieurs antibiotiques.




Vos tâches comprendront, par ailleurs :

Contribuer à l'organisation de la réception, du traitement, de la validation et de l'analyse des données, ainsi qu'à la communication des résultats issus du suivi épidémiologique national des infections nosocomiales au sein des hôpitaux généraux.
Développer et maintenir des procédures structurées et reproductibles, telles que des scripts ou des pipelines de données, à l'aide des outils disponibles tels que SAS, R, STATA, MS Excel et Latex.
Contribuer à la maintenance, au suivi et à l’adaptation des outils de collecte locale de données en collaboration avec le service Healthdata ou le service TIC.
Valoriser les résultats et les méthodologies au sein de groupes de travail, de colloques et de congrès nationaux et internationaux.
Participer à des projets du Centre européen de prévention et de contrôle des maladies (ECDC).
Collaborer avec le secteur des soins de santé, les collaborateurs scientifiques et les experts en informatique.




Le profil

Diplôme : Master ingénieur civil, biologique ou industriel ; mathématiques ; informatique ; statistiques ou bio-informatique

Compétences génériques : bonnes compétences en communication, orienté client, méthodique, organisé et capable de résoudre les problèmes

Compétences techniques :

bonne connaissance et/ou expérience des méthodes et outils de traitement, d'analyse et de reporting des données, tels que SAS, R, STATA
bonne connaissance et/ou une expérience des concepts et techniques d’intégration et de flux de données
connaissance et/ou une expérience des concepts et techniques d’entrepôt de données, par exemple SQL, est un atout
connaissance et/ou une expérience des outils de collecte de données tels que LimeSurvey, Redcap ou autres, constitue un atout
connaissance et/ou expérience de la réglementation et/ou de la gouvernance en matière de collecte de données à caractère personnel
vif intérêt pour la santé publique, les maladies infectieuses et la recherche scientifique

Connaissances linguistiques :

Parfaite maitrise d’une des deux langues nationales (FR ou NL)
Bonne connaissance active de l’anglais




L'offre

Un contrat à durée déterminée à partir du 01/10/2026 (pour une durée de 12 mois) au sein d’un institut scientifique de renom

Une rémunération claire et transparente : votre rémunération est établie selon les barèmes publiques fédéraux; échelle de rémunération : SW11, pour autant que les conditions reprises sous la rubrique profil soient remplies, et en fonction de l’expérience pertinente à la fonction

Title: Junior Data Scientist
HTML:
Om ons data team verder te versterken, zoeken we een enthousiaste Junior Data Scientist.


Christeyns is een Belgische specialist in hygiëne- en reinigingsoplossingen voor onder meer wasserijen, de voedingsindustrie, schoonmaakbedrijven en de gezondheidszorg. De groep combineert de ontwikkeling en productie van reinigings- en desinfectieproducten met apparatuur, engineering, digitale toepassingen en technische dienstverlening.


Met meer dan 1.800 medewerkers en 47 dochterondernemingen wereldwijd rapporteerde Christeyns in 2025 een omzet van meer dan 487 miljoen euro. Het familiebedrijf werd opgericht in 1946 en is sinds 1989 in handen van de familie Bostoen.


Functieomschrijving


Bij Christeyns zetten we data om in waardevolle inzichten. Als internationale B2B-speler in de hygiënechemie investeren we sterk in een toekomstgerichte data-omgeving die onze bedrijfsprocessen en duurzaamheidsambities ondersteunt.


Om ons data team verder te versterken, zoeken we een enthousiaste Junior Data Scientist. In deze rol krijg je de kans om je analytische vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen en stap voor stap door te groeien naar een functie als Business Analyst. Je werkt mee aan projecten die een directe impact hebben op de werking en besluitvorming binnen onze internationale organisatie.


Jouw functie


  • Je vertaalt ruwe en complexe data uit verschillende interne en externe bronnen naar heldere, bruikbare inzichten voor proceseigenaars en management, zodat beslissingen onderbouwd en datagedreven kunnen worden genomen.
  • Je ontwerpt, ontwikkelt en onderhoudt dashboards, datamodellen en API's die bedrijfsprocessen meetbaar, stuurbaar en transparant maken binnen een internationale organisatie.
  • Je werkt actief mee aan de verdere uitbouw en optimalisatie van de data-architectuur en -infrastructuur, waarbij betrouwbaarheid, performantie en schaalbaarheid centraal staan.
  • Je ontsluit data via gebruiksvriendelijke visualisaties en rapporteringen in tools zoals Power BI en Grafana, ondersteund door Databricks en Microsoft Azure.
  • Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor duurzaamheids- en ESG-gerelateerde data en zorgt voor correcte definities, consistente datasets en duidelijke rapportering ter ondersteuning van strategische doelstellingen.
  • Waar relevant pas je machine learning en geavanceerde analysetechnieken toe om patronen te identificeren, inzichten te verdiepen en data verder te verrijken.
  • Je stemt noden en verwachtingen rond data, visualisatie en voorspellende modellen af met proceseigenaars en werkt hiervoor nauw samen met IT en het data team.
  • Je rapporteert aan de Data Team Lead


Profiel


  • Bachelor of Master in Data Science, Toegepaste Informatica, Handelsingenieur, Economie of een vergelijkbare richting;
  • Je bent een starter of hebt een eerste relevante ervaring via stage, studentenjob of een eerste werkervaring;
  • Interesse in data-analyse, bedrijfsprocessen en business intelligence;
  • Basiskennis van SQL, Power BI of Python is een pluspunt;
  • Interesse om door te groeien richting Business Analytics;
  • Zeer goede kennis van Nederlands en Engels.


Aanbod


  • Een uitdagende startersfunctie binnen een internationale en groeiende organisatie;
  • Begeleiding en opleiding door ervaren collega's;
  • Werken in een gemotiveerd en dynamisch data team;
  • Ruimte voor initiatief, persoonlijke ontwikkeling en professionele groei;
  • Een marktconform salarispakket met extralegale voordelen.

Title: Principal Computational Methodologist (Belgium)
Description:
Make your mark for patients

We are looking for a Principal Computational Methodologist who is curious, collaborative, and impact-driven to join our Advanced Methods and Data Science team within Biometrics and Data Science, based in any of our Brussels (Belgium), Slough (UK) or Raleigh (US).




About The Role

You will help shape how advanced AI, machine learning, and computational methods support clinical development. You will design, validate, and deploy models that help teams make evidence-based decisions in areas such as biomarker discovery, clinical trial design, operational efficiency, and patient experience. You will guide scientific thinking, turn complex methods into practical solutions, and help build scalable tools that meet scientific, technical, and regulatory expectations.




Who You Will Work With

You will join Advanced Methods and Data Science, part of Biometrics and Data Science within Patient Evidence. You will work with clinical, statistical, molecular, operational, engineering, IT, governance, and compliance colleagues across countries. You will also connect with academic, technology, and industry partners. Together, you will explore new methods, share scientific learning, and support teams that use data to improve decision-making across the drug development value chain.




What You Will Do

You will lead AI and machine learning projects that address clinical development, biomarker, operational, and decision-support needs.
You will design, build, test, and refine modern deep learning models for text, graphs, biological sequences, and clinical data.
You will develop generative AI applications using foundation models, pre-trained models, and large language models.
You will run rigorous, reproducible AI experiments on internal and public datasets to generate publishable scientific results.
You will partner with engineering teams to package methods into applications, platforms, and scalable validated solutions.
You will mentor colleagues, share knowledge, and represent the team through publications, presentations, and external collaborations.




Interested? For this role, we are looking for the following education, experience, and skills:

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. Job Function

Data Analytics & Computational Sciences

Job Sub Function

Biostatistics

Job Category

Scientific/Technology

All Job Posting Locations:

Beerse, Antwerp, Belgium, High Wycombe, Buckinghamshire, United Kingdom, Hyderabad, Andhra Pradesh, India, Leiden, South Holland, Netherlands, Mumbai, India

Job Description

Senior Scientist, Scientific Computing

Statistics & Decision Sciences (SDS) is a function of Quantitative Sciences & Clinical Pharmacology. SDS comprises of Cardiopulmonary, Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience, Medical Affairs, Post Approval Lifecycle Management, Discovery & Manufacturing Statistics, Statistical Modeling & Methodology & Consulting and Strategic Business & Computing Operations.

The SBCO organization applies deep understanding of drug development, statistics, scientific computing, business operations, and enabling technologies to deliver scalable, compliant, and high‑value solutions for SDS. SBCO comprises three integrated units: Strategy & Business Operations (SBO), Scientific Computing Operations (SCO), and the SDS Centralized Administrative Network (SCAN).

Position Summary

The Senior Scientist, Scientific Computing provides technical and scientific computing support to advance statistical and strategic innovation, automation, and reproducibility across Statistics & Decision Sciences (SDS). The role helps ensure that platforms, tools, and data practices are robust, compliant, and aligned to business and regulatory needs.

The Senior Scientist, Scientific Computing, provides technical support and delivery for scientific computing and business capabilities within Statistics & Decision Sciences (SDS). The role collaborates with key stakeholders to drive and develop fit-for-purpose, compliant, and scalable solutions. Responsibilities include support for evaluation, integration, and lifecycle management of statistical and business analytical tools; establishing and maintaining validated data storage, archival, and data-flow strategies and effective training, adoption, and collaboration practices across SDS.

Principal Responsibilities


Exhibits effective software expertise through applied experience, grounded in scientific and business principles with a proven record of effectively supporting strategic efforts. Demonstrates competence in utilizing computational tools to analyze and visualize data for research and business objectives related to studies, experiments, trials, and processes. This includes full proficiency in relevant computational and scripting tools, including artificial intelligence (AI).
This role goes beyond model prototyping. You will own the AI/ML layer end to end, from architecture and evaluation to the cloud infrastructure it runs on. You’ll work closely with statisticians and programmers, so comfort with R/Python for statistical work and data visualization is important, not optional.
Design and build RAG pipelines, agent workflows, and prompt/context strategies across our AI initiatives.
Set up and maintain repositories, CI/CD pipelines, and development environments for the wider SDS team.
Supports Scientific Software Packages, High Performance Computing (HPC) Hardware and platforms, communication tools, and standards and good practices documentation. Also supports business system and process improvement areas.
Identifies and implements innovative tools and solutions in process automation and scientific computing domains. Identifies and implements advanced techniques to address complex project or program features. Proven ability in problem-solving and troubleshooting, including supporting strategic scenario planning, quantitative decision-making, and business support.
Collaborates cross-functionally to identify and resolve issues. Successfully addresses business needs through enhanced insights, productivity, and efficiency. Advises management of opportunities to increase compatibility, interoperability, stability and usability of solution architecture.
Demonstrates strong skills in building relationships across functions. Is accountable as a point of contact for a specific project or effort.
Collaborates effectively with SDS colleagues and external partners to meet program needs. Works cross-functionally to identify and resolve issues.
Shares knowledge within and across functions. Represents Statistics & Decision Sciences in cross-functional and intra-departmental teams or working groups pertaining to scientific or process initiatives. Builds cross-functional partnerships with internal colleagues and external partners (e.g., contractors, consultants) to achieve results for project-specific needs, focusing one enhancing communication, efficiency, and productivity.
Supervise contractors/special assignment personnel/interns/co-ops as required.
Exhibits strong written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills, and demonstrates proficiency in collaborating with by translating intricate technical concepts for drug research and development partners. Effectively communicates findings to program stakeholders and broader non-technical audiences with visuals and storytelling.
Takes responsibility and accountability for the quality and timeliness of project deliverables as assessed by stakeholders from respective projects or programs. Follows best practices for Software Engineering, Project Management, and Data Integrity. Aligns with partners following best practices for Good Clinical, Manufacturing, Laboratory, or other pertinent GxP activities and requirements. Complies with organization and company standard operating procedures in a timely fashion, such as required training and project time reporting. Ensures that documents, programs, and all other deliverables are consistent and adhere to project and company standards.
Stand up and manage MCP servers connecting AI tools to internal data sources and applications.


Qualifications


PhD in in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Computational Biology, Engineering or a related quantitative field or Master’s with 3 to 5 years of software/ML engineering experience, including 1 to 2+ years working hands-on with LLMs in production.


Technical Skills


Strong Python; experience building production services, not just notebooks
Working proficiency in R programming(or strong willingness/ability to read and work with R)
Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar) and at least one agent framework (e.g. LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or a custom framework)
Databases
Understanding of LLM failure modes (hallucination, context drift, prompt injection) and mitigation strategies.
Hands-on AWS (S3, EC2, GPU instances) or Azure equivalent, including basic IAM/security and cost management
Git-based workflows, CI/CD, containerization (Docker)
Experience setting up MCP servers or comparable integration/orchestration tooling.


Required Skills

Preferred Skills:

Advanced Analytics, Biostatistics, Clinical Trials, Collaboration, Consulting, Critical Thinking, Data Privacy Standards, Data Quality, Data Savvy, Digital Fluency, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), Quality Assurance (QA), Report Writing, Standard Operating Procedure (SOP), Statistical Analysis Systems (SAS) Programming, Statistics, Systems Development, Technologically Savvy

Title: Specialist Tech – Data Scientist (M/V/X)
Description:
Werkomgeving

De Algemene Dienst Inlichting en Veiligheid (ADIV) – QUAERO ET TEGO: IK ONDERZOEK EN BESCHERM

De bedreigingen voor onze samenleving veranderen voortdurend. ADIV is de Belgische referentiedienst voor inlichtingen wat betreft Defensie en het buitenland. Met onze inlichtingen dragen we bij tot het beschermen van de belangen van Defensie, ons land en zijn bevolking. We hebben een diepgaand inzicht in de huidige en toekomstige uitdagingen op het gebied van inlichtingen, veiligheid en cyberspace. Dankzij een geïntegreerde aanpak, zowel nationaal als internationaal, werken we samen met onze verschillende partners om de interne veiligheid te handhaven en te versterken.

De Cyber Command is een cross-functionele eenheid die binnen Defensie zal groeien, terwijl het deel blijft uitmaken van ADIV, waarvan het het wettelijke kader en de missies deelt. Het heeft een dubbele rol. Cyber Command is verantwoordelijk voor de cyberbeveiliging van de netwerken en wapensystemen die door Defensie worden gebruikt, maar ook voor het verzamelen van informatie en het uitvoeren van operaties in cyberspace namens ADIV.

Binnen deze context bouwt het Tech Team van de Digital Influence Collection Unit (DICU) aan innovatieve oplossingen voor data-analyse, infrastructuur en cybersecurity. DICU steunt op twee pijlers:


Open Source Intelligence (OSINT): evolueert mee met moderne technologieën zoals machine learning en sociale media en vormt een essentiële pijler binnen het inlichtingenwerk.
Information Warfare (IW): bestrijdt desinformatie en fake news door geavanceerde technologieën in te zetten om online content te analyseren, te verifiëren en te lokaliseren – cruciaal in moderne conflicten.


Taakomschrijving

Als Specialist Tech – Data Scientist werkt u aan innovatieve oplossingen voor OSINT en cyberoperaties. Uw verantwoordelijkheden omvatten:


Voorbereiden en beheren van datasets (leaks, open source) en integreren in veilige databases
Ontwikkelen van intuïtieve interfaces (GUI) voor data-exploratie en gebruikersinteractie
Testen en implementeren van big data-technologieën zoals ELK Stack en graph databases (bv. ArangoDB)
Ontwerpen van cloudarchitecturen volgens best practices inzake veiligheid en schaalbaarheid
Opzetten van CI/CD pipelines en zero-trustoplossingen voor veilige en efficiënte ontwikkeling
Creëren van containeromgevingen (Docker, Kubernetes) voor flexibele en robuuste toepassingen
Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van anonieme netwerken en IT-infrastructuur voor veilige communicatie
Uitvoeren van risicoanalyses en security audits en definiëren van cybersecurity policies
Ondersteunen van OSINT- en IW-teams met technische expertise en probleemoplossing
Organiseren van trainingen en workshops en actief kennis delen binnen het team


Profielomschrijving


Je bent in het bezit van een Master- of Bachelordiploma in IT, of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
Je bent vertrouwd met programmeertalen zoals Python en hebt kennis van big data-technologieën, cloudplatformen en containertechnologie.
Je hebt ervaring met data-analyse, modellering en visualisatie.
Je bent analytisch, oplossingsgericht en innovatief ingesteld.
Je beschikt over goede communicatieve vaardigheden en kan complexe materie helder uitleggen.
Je bent een teamplayer, maar kan ook zelfstandig werken.
Een degelijke kennis van het technisch Engels is onontbeerlijk.


Je hebt de Belgische nationaliteit en komt in aanmerking voor Belgische, NAVO- en EU-veiligheidsmachtiging “Zeer Geheim”.

Troeven


Goede kennis van het Frans (tweetalige werkomgeving).
Ervaring met OSINT, cybersecurity en risk management.
Certificaten in data science, cloud of cybersecurity.
Ervaring met CI/CD, zero trust en infrastructuurarchitectuur.


Arbeidsvoorwaarden

Als je geselecteerd wordt, moet je op de datum van indiensttreding voldoen aan de volgende voorwaarden om aan de slag te kunnen:


Belg zijn.
Burgerlijke en politieke rechten genieten.
Van goed gedrag zijn in overeenstemming met de vereisten van de betreffende functie.
In het bezit zijn van een veiligheidsmachtiging “Zeer Geheim” vereist door de functie of bereid zijn om een veiligheidsonderzoek “Zeer Geheim” te ondergaan alvorens in dienst te treden, met de verplichting om een positief resultaat te behalen, zo niet zou dit aanleiding geven tot uitsluiting uit de dienst (conform de wet van 11 december 1998 betreffende de classificatie en de veiligheidsmachtigingen, -attesten en -adviezen, gewijzigd door de wet van 03-05-2005).


Solliciteer je voor een functie binnen ADIV, wees dan discreet en beperk je communicatie hierover, ook binnen je onmiddellijke omgeving.

Wij bieden

Onze federale overheid is volop aan het informatiseren : van cybersecurity uitdagingen tot digitale communicatie, van netwerkverbeteringen om onze nieuwe manier van werken te ondersteunen tot complexe ontwikkelingsprojecten en optimalisatietrajecten van bestaande applicaties.

Wil je hieraan meewerken en zo een maatschappelijke meerwaarde creëren, terwijl je ook aan je persoonlijke ontwikkeling kunt werken en maximale mogelijkheden krijgt om je ambities waar te maken ? Dan bieden we je een duidelijk doel in een stimulerende omgeving en een zeer competitief salarispakket met een hele reeks extralegale voordelen (hospitalisatieverzekering, maaltijdcheques, mobiliteit, pensioenfonds,…).

Tevens hechten we veel belang aan een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé – met telewerk voor de meeste functies – en zijn onze kantoren zeer goed bereikbaar met het openbaar vervoer.
